name: Tax Justice Network Africa
detail: Only evidence is its name on the 2023 global campaign roster; the Tanzania link (briefing page) could not be opened and does not mention a wealth tax. No act in or towards Tanzania.

name: ActionAid International
detail: Global proposal (2016) and 2023 campaign roster; the Arusha meeting only discussed wealth tax and the Tanzanian affiliate is not shown to take a position.

name: Tax Justice Network
detail: Global net wealth tax research; its Tanzania case study concerns mining tax sovereignty, not a wealth tax. No act in or towards Tanzania.

name: Kanisa la Mennonite Tanzania
detail: Signatory of the UN tax-convention submission (Dec 2025 and Mar 2026 versions). The submission never names a wealth tax: it asks for effective taxation of high-net-worth individuals and international taxing rights over where their wealth originated, which is not a tax on the stock of wealth.
